name: Sayama Erina
source:
The teacher of [url=/c78405]Ryoutarou[/url] class.

She’s popular among her students, who affectionately call her ‘Miss Eri.’ As she’s easy to approach, they often come to her for advice, but the sheer number of students who want to talk to her can be a little overwhelming at times.

“While you’re studying here, I want you to find what’s most important to you.”

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1490&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
